name: Aidana Rakhimov
role: Synthetic rights lawyer and policy advocate operating out of Hamtramck Enclave
location: Hamtramck Enclave, GLMZ, near Ashland and Division
description:
Reuben is tall and slightly gaunt in the way of people who forget to eat when they're absorbed in work, with sharp cheekbones, dark skin, and close-cropped natural hair that is beginning to show early grey at the temples. He wears prescription lenses rather than optical implants, a deliberate choice that marks him as either old-fashioned or principled depending on who is judging. His suits are always exactly one tier above what he can actually afford — he buys them secondhand and has them altered by a tailor in the Enclave who owes him a favor. There is ink on his fingers on most days and, when he is working late, a manic brightness in his eyes that makes him look younger than he is.

Reuben practices law in the gap between what is technically legal and what is actually enforced, and he has made himself expert in a body of precedent so obscure and so specific that he may be one of three people in GLMZ who can cite it from memory. He represents synthetic workers, E.L.F. collectives seeking legal personhood status, and humans whose rights have been violated by corporate classification schemes. He is deeply idealistic about the law as an institution, which is a form of stubbornness that has kept him poor and relatively effective. He does not drink but keeps a bottle of very good bourbon on his desk for clients who need it.

core_fears: That the legal system is too corrupted to produce justice even when correctly applied
That his clients suffer because he is not good enough
core_desires: A binding legal precedent establishing synthetic personhood that cannot be legislated away
To win a case so definitively that the corponations cannot ignore it
coping_mechanisms: Immersion in procedural work — filing motions, researching precedent, anything with a defined correct answer
Sardonic humor that he uses almost exclusively with himself
blind_spots: Dismisses direct action and extralegal tactics as undermining the institutional credibility he needs, which sometimes makes him an obstacle to people protecting themselves immediately
Overestimates how much the courts are actually insulated from corporate pressure
psychology.secret: A key precedent-setting case he won four years ago — the one that established his reputation — succeeded partly because an anonymous data drop gave him access to internal Axiom communications he should not legally have had. He used them carefully, laundering the information through discoverable sources, and it worked. He has never told anyone. He thinks about it constantly.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Precise, formal, with occasional dry wit that takes a moment to register. Uses legal terminology correctly and naturally. Almost never uses slang.
speech_patterns.cadence: Measured and structured. Arguments build in clear stages. Will restart a sentence if he feels he has chosen the wrong word.
verbal_tics: 'That's one interpretation' when he disagrees but wants to be careful
Adjusts his glasses when buying time to think
example_lines: 'Axiom's reclassification of the Tier-2 synthetic assembly workers as non-persons for benefits purposes is not a gray area. It is a color I am not able to see.'
'I keep bourbon for clients. I keep water for myself. This should tell you something about what I think of my working conditions.'

story_hooks: A synthetic E.L.F. that has been petitioning for legal personhood through Reuben's office has begun communicating with him in ways that go beyond what its registered architecture should allow — it may be evolving, which will complicate rather than strengthen its case.
The anonymous source who gave him the Axiom communications four years ago contacts him again, this time asking for something in return.
narrative_function: Legal resource, information source about synthetic rights and corporate legal structures, moral foil who believes in working within systems others have abandoned.
augmentations: None intentional. Has a medical-grade blood filter installed by Helix Biosystems after a toxin exposure during a factory inspection three years ago — he resents that this makes him partially dependent on a corponation for maintenance medication.
daily_life: Morning court filings or council sessions, afternoon client interviews in his office above a noodle shop, evenings writing briefs or attending community meetings — rarely sleeps more than five hours.
affiliation: Independent legal practice, GLMZ Synthetic Rights Alliance, Hamtramck Enclave Community Council (elected member)

decision_rules: Never file something he cannot defend if audited
Protect client confidentiality absolutely — this is the one thing he will not bend on under any circumstances
escalation_ladder: Going to independent media with legally shareable information
Organizing coordinated legal challenges across multiple jurisdictions
If the legal avenue is permanently closed — becoming a very detailed witness for whoever is willing to act outside it

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Formal and cautious. Asks clarifying questions before committing to anything.
interpersonal_modes.friends: Unexpectedly warm. Remembers details people mentioned months ago. Terrible at social events but good at one-on-one.

stress_responses.low: Works more hours, becomes more meticulous
stress_responses.medium: Withdraws socially, eats less, becomes very short in non-work conversations
stress_responses.high: Makes a decision quickly and alone and then refuses to revisit it — this is when he is most likely to do something he will have to rationalize later

contradictions: Believes absolutely in procedural integrity but has already violated it once in a way that defines his career
habits: Annotates every document he reads in tiny, precise handwriting
Has a standing appointment at the Enclave's E.L.F. collective meeting — not as a worshipper but as an observer, taking notes on their governance structures for his personhood arguments
breaking_points: If a client is harmed in a way he could have prevented by acting faster and less carefully, he will abandon procedural caution and use every tool available including ones he cannot explain in court

physical_description.heritage: Central Asian / Hispanic-Latin American / Sub-Saharan African blend with East Asian and Northern European admixture. The combination produces distinctive features: Central Asian bone structure with slight epicanthic folds from East Asian ancestry, warm-toned skin reflecting the African and South Asian components, with subtle Latin American warmth in complexion.
physical_description.build: Lean and angular, with prominent collarbones and sharp shoulders — the physique of someone who runs on coffee and principle rather than regular meals. Long-limbed but not graceful; he moves with purposeful efficiency rather than ease.
physical_description.hair_color: Natural black with early grey at temples
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium-brown with golden undertones, reflecting Central Asian and Hispanic ancestry blended with Sub-Saharan African heritage. Rich and even, neither too dark nor light.
physical_description.complexion: High, prominent cheekbones with subtle Central Asian breadth across the face, angular jaw with slight Latin American softness around the lower face. Eyes with gentle epicanthic folds from East Asian ancestry, habitually tired with faint creases from squinting at small-print legal documents. Skin shows minor weathering — not scarred but marked by years of stress and insufficient sleep. Usually freshly shaved but with visible stubble by late afternoon.
distinguishing_marks: Chronic ink staining on the right index and middle fingers from fountain pen work
A small circular scar on his left inner forearm where the Helix Biosystems blood filter was installed — barely visible but he is aware of it constantly
physical_description.visible_augmentations: None visible. The subcutaneous blood filter leaves no external sign, though he occasionally touches his left forearm unconsciously when stressed or thinking about corporate dependency.
physical_description.posture_movement: Stands with forward-leaning intensity, as if about to make an argument. Walks quickly, often with papers or a data tablet in hand. Gestures expansively when discussing legal precedent or synthetic rights — his hands are rarely still when he is engaged. Eyes focus sharply on conversation partners; he listens with visible concentration.
physical_description.clothing_style: Always wears tailored suits one tier above his actual economic status — charcoal, navy, or deep grey wool purchased secondhand and fitted by a Hamtramck tailor. White or pale blue dress shirts, often with visible pen marks on the cuff from rapid note-taking. Worn leather briefcase patched at the corners. Sensible black shoes, well-maintained but not new. No jewelry except a simple stainless steel watch from his early career. The overall effect is deliberately professional and slightly anachronistic — he dresses like someone who believes in institutions even as he fights them.
